Hindu Temple in Ohio Attacked with Bricks While Devotees Were Inside

A Hindu temple in the Greater Cleveland area of Ohio was attacked with bricks on Friday afternoon, shattering its windows while priests and devotees were inside. The Shree Swaminarayan Hindu Temple Vadtaldham was targeted during daylight hours. Two US-based Hindu advocacy groups, the Coalition of Hindus of North America (CoHNA) and another unnamed group, reported the incident. The Indian-American community in Ohio was preparing to celebrate Hindu Heritage Month.
